topic: Sensor data discrepancy at Santo Amaro Platform
summary_markdown: A sensor located at the RZK_BR_Santo_Amaro_Platform (Facility #27086) was reported to be sending approximately 500 packets per hour since November 19th, when its expected rate is 720 packets per hour. A graph was provided for comparison.
action_items: Investigate the sensor data discrepancy at RZK_BR_Santo_Amaro_Platform.
